en.html:
I sent Ichijou out first and stayed on in the quarters for a little while.

Today's program was simple: divide the rounds between us and have a look through the castle. Officially we were doing liaison work, carrying messages to the various departments inside.

The messages were not very urgent or very secret, but had to be delivered by mouth. Such liaison is one of the daily duties of a public officer attached to the Mandokoro. So if two such officers are seen wandering here and there, that need not look suspicious in itself. For once, wandering about was the official duty.

Even if a patrolling soldier stops us, Ms Iwata guaranteed, we only have to show some suitable papers and say this much, and we will be released at once. For two people who want to earn their information with their own feet, no better condition could be found anywhere.

Information, yes, that is the word. And not the kind already converted into sentences. We needed raw information. To decide what to do, and even more to do it, we first had to get a firsthand feel for the castle's present state. Without that, nothing starts.

Our job, simply put, was to give Doushin Yusa one unpleasant shock. But making that enormous monk say "arre baap re" even once looked more difficult than crossing the ocean in a log canoe. We could not move carelessly.

Timepass was not a strategy either. After one full night, Ichijou was still wearing menace around herself like a coat.

If one was generous, it could pass for the nerves of a new castle employee. That was the only comfort.

一条を先に送り出し、俺は<ruby>暫<rt>しばら</rt></ruby>く宿舎に留まった。

　今日の予定は手分けしての城内見回りだ。
　名目は、城内各部署への連絡事務である。

　緊急性と機密性は高くないが口頭通達の必要がある
連絡は、政所に属する公人が日常的に担う職務の一つ。
　つまりふらふら出歩いていようと、不審を買うには
あたらない。

　警邏の兵士に見咎められても、適当な書類を見せて
そう説明すればすぐ解放されると岩田女史は保証した。
　足で情報を稼ぎたいこちらにとって、これほどの好
条件も他に無かろう。

　情報――そう情報だ。それも文章に変換されたもの
ではない、<ruby>生<rt>き</rt></ruby>の情報が要る。
　すべき行動を策定するにも実行するにも、まず城の
現状をもう少し肌で知らぬことには始まらない。

　言うなれば遊佐童心に一泡吹かせるのが俺と一条の
仕事なのだが、あの大入道をして「うわぁ」と言わし
めるのは丸木舟で大洋を横断するより困難そうである。
　<ruby>軽々<rt>けいけい</rt></ruby>には動けなかった。

　とはいえやはり、時間を掛けるのも下策だろう。
　一晩経っても一条は相変わらず、剣呑な気配を衣の
ように纏いつけている。

　城勤めの緊張で気が立っていると見えなくもないの
がせめてもの救いだが。

en.html: So that was how she had come to be sent here. True, even if somebody wanted to take Princess Sakurako away, they could not reach her inside this castle—◆no. To decide that was premature. Right now, in this very castle, one man hostile to Rokuhara had already got inside. I could not say there were no others. ...In which case, the end waiting for that princess was easy to see. Not now. Acting now would stir up public feeling. One year from now, or two, when the name of Okabe had faded from people's memory. Quietly. That, I supposed, would be the way.

So that was how she had come to be sent here.

True, even if somebody wanted to take Princess Sakurako away, they could not reach her inside this castle—◆no. To decide that was premature.

Right now, in this very castle, one man hostile to Rokuhara had already got inside. I could not say there were no others.

...In which case, the end waiting for that princess was easy to see.

Not now. Acting now would stir up public feeling. One year from now, or two, when the name of Okabe had faded from people's memory.

Quietly. That, I supposed, would be the way.

ja.text:
送られてきたというわけか。
　確かに、桜子姫を欲する者がいたとしても、この城
までは手を伸ばせなかろう――◆いや。決め付けるのは
早計だ。

　現に、ここにこうして反六波羅的な男が侵入を果た
している。
　他にもいないとは言い切れまい。

　……となると、あの姫君の末路は見えている。

　今ではない。今手を下せば人心を刺激する。一年か
二年後、岡部の名が人々の記憶から薄らいだ頃。
　密かに――――で、あろう。
